what: a curvature-continuous fillet (equivalent radius 2) of the three edges at a top corner of a bar whose far end runs tangent into a cylinder: it built with SMLib's own corner patch, tangent to the rounds only (a 35.8 / mm curvature jump), seen as a dome on the corner; the corner must be a G2 patch; reported from the app (2026-10-30, test-peg part)
